limits.R1: Form means the eight ports and which Knodes each reaches. Whether the nine behave as one Knode (one move, one gate) is not tested here; tools/fraktal_run.py runs a move.
limits.R2: Counts and positions only. That three layers and three sides are the right number is taken as given.
limits.R3: Ports are matched by direction and strand. What travels through a port, and whether two Knodes agree on its content, is not modelled.
limits.R4: A strand exists if one link says so. Nothing checks that a real line, call or record stands behind the link.
limits.R5: It reads links between Knodes only; what a Korner is for is not modelled, so nothing is checked at one.
limits.R7: Distance is counted on the three by three. A link between levels, from a Knode to one inside another, cannot be written, so it is not checked.
limits.R8: Order only. No move is executed and no refusal exists in the model, so 'only Now may refuse' is not tested.
limits.R9: The shell is compared with the Knode's ports by kind; no link joins an outer port to an inner one.
